edges.reason: msg.sender is checked in require(msg.sender==vrfAddress) to authorize receiveApproval.
msg.sender is used as the bettor identity when placing an ETH bet.
msg.sender must match the last queued bettor in cancelBet.
msg.sender is compared to the last bettor in the canCancelBet view.
State variable vrfAddress is the trusted address compared against msg.sender.
from parameter flows into the transferFrom call and _placeBet.
tokens parameter flows into transferFrom and _placeBet.
token parameter is part of the receiveApproval signature.
data parameter is forwarded to _placeBet as the victory message.
victoryMessage flows into _placeBet from placeBetEth.
numTokens is stored into betQueue inside _placeBet.
from is stored as the bettor inside _placeBet.
victoryMessage is written to victoryMessages inside _placeBet.
to parameter is the recipient of the external token transfer in payout.
numTokens parameter is the amount transferred in payout.
upper parameter is used as the modulo bound in random.
blockn parameter is forwarded to maxRandom.
entropy parameter is forwarded to maxRandom.
blockn parameter is used in blockhash inside maxRandom.
entropy parameter is hashed with blockhash in maxRandom.
bettor parameter is compared against queued bettors in getBetState.
num parameter is parity-checked in isEven.
local tokensBefore is computed and subtracted to derive the bet amount.
local totalbet aggregates the paired bet amounts.
local randval decides the winner of the paired bets.
local i is the queue iteration counter in getBetState.
local randomNumber is the return value of maxRandom.
local randomNumber is the return value of random.
receiveApproval triggers the external transferFrom call.
receiveApproval calls _placeBet after pulling tokens.
placeBetEth forwards msg.value to the external buyTokens call.
placeBetEth calls _placeBet with the tokens bought.
_placeBet calls resolvePriorBets before queueing the new bet.
resolvePriorBets calls payout repeatedly inside the while loop before index is advanced.
payout performs an external token transfer that can reenter resolvePriorBets before index is updated.
cancelBet calls resolvePriorBets before checking cancel eligibility.
cancelBet reads indexBetPlace and index to validate the lone remaining bet.
canCancelBet reads indexBetPlace for the parity check.
canCancelBet reads index to compute the pending bet count.
canCancelBet reads the last entry of betQueue.
getBetState reads betQueue entries between index and indexBetPlace.
resolvePriorBets reads pairs of bets from betQueue.
_placeBet writes the new Bet struct into betQueue.
_placeBet writes the victory message to victoryMessages.
resolvePriorBets advances index after each resolved pair.
_placeBet increments indexBetPlace after queueing.
placeBetEth reads vrfcontract.balanceOf before and after buying tokens.
exchangecontract is the target of the buyTokens call in placeBetEth.

Parameter token is used only within receiveApproval.
Parameter data is forwarded directly to _placeBet from receiveApproval.
Parameter victoryMessage is only consumed by placeBetEth.
Parameter numTokens is only used inside _placeBet.
Parameter from is only used inside _placeBet.
Parameter victoryMessage is only written to storage inside _placeBet.
Parameter to is only used by payout.
Parameter numTokens is only used by payout.
Parameter upper is only used by random.
Parameter blockn is only forwarded by random.
Parameter entropy is only forwarded by random.
Parameter blockn is only used by maxRandom.
Parameter entropy is only used by maxRandom.
Parameter bettor is only compared against queue entries in getBetState.
Parameter num is only used by the parity helper isEven.
Local balance snapshot exists only inside placeBetEth.
Local totalbet is computed only inside resolvePriorBets.
Local randval is computed only inside resolvePriorBets.
Loop counter i exists only inside getBetState.
Returned local randomNumber exists only inside maxRandom.
Returned local randomNumber exists only inside random.
